verdict.rationale: PostHog provides automation building blocks—CDP pipelines that run in realtime or on a schedule, workflow automation for actions/messages, alerting on insights, and AI-authored Hog functions—that can operate in the background without manual triggering. However, its AI-agent features (MCP, PostHog AI) are framed as interactive assistants invoked from an editor/chat rather than fully autonomous standing agents, and one community report notes friction with the LLM/cohort features.
